newsitem.title: USA: N.J. lawmakers revamp school funding plan - paper.
newsitem.headline: N.J. lawmakers revamp school funding plan - paper.

text.p: New Jersey Republican lawmakers plan to unveil a school funding plan that would set spending levels about $55 million higher than Gov Christine Whitman proposed, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Friday.
Details of the plan were expected to be released Friday at a hearing of the Senate Education Committee.
New Jersey is working under a court-imposed deadline of Dec 31 to devise a plan to equalize spending between the state's rich and poor school districts.

Whitman recently released a proposal for a core curriculum for all districts, but critics said it would force wealthy districts to curb spending. Lawmakers have been meeting for weeks to try to find compromise language that could pass the Legislature.
